title: 第三轮：5G 样式选择 + 手电筒亮度控制修复后的统一编译/测试/安装

device.launchProbe: am start -W .ui.SettingsActivity -> Status: ok; adb logcat crash buffer has no HyperExtend entry and no FATAL/AndroidRuntime line

fixesInThisPass.upstream: library/core/.../system_ui_control_center_tiles.xml DropDownPreference prefs_key_system_control_center_5g_new_tile (0..3); FiveGTile.java mode 1/2 = independent tiles with different icons, mode 3 = inject into the native cellular detail page
fixesInThisPass.local: FiveGTileSettings.style (control_center_fix_tiles_list.5g_style) surfaced as a row of the 补全磁贴列表 card, with 样式一 / 样式二 / 内置移动网络磁贴; independent tile path = FiveGTileHooks, native-detail path = FiveGDetailHooks; StockTilesHooks keeps the tile out of the candidate list when the native-detail style is selected

fixesInThisPass.defect: 手电筒亮度控制与西米露实现不一致
fixesInThisPass.upstream: NewFlashLight.kt hijacks the brightness slider while the torch is on and writes the converted strength into hard-coded sysfs nodes after chmod 777
fixesInThisPass.whyNotCopiedVerbatim: None of upstream's sysfs nodes exist on this device (/sys/class/flashlight_core, leds/flashlight, led:torch_0, led:switch_0, spotlight all absent; only yellow:flash-0 / white:flash-1 / amber:flash-2). The host's own FLASH_DEVICES paths are absent too, and MiuiFlashlightControllerImpl reaches the torch through CameraManager.turnOnTorchWithStrengthLevel. Upstream modes 2/3 only describe how to write a node that does not exist here, so no fake tabs were added.
fixesInThisPass.local: 手电筒亮度控制 card has two tabs: 开启时限制上限 (first-pass cap, preserved) and 亮度条实时控制 (upstream-equivalent: hook MiuiBrightnessController.onChanged, temporarily set mExternalChange, convert the slider value with the host's own BrightnessUtils.convertGammaToLinearFloat, call CameraManager.turnOnTorchWithStrengthLevel)
fixesInThisPass.extraRepair: Removed the mandatory deoptimize() of the evidence-only anchors (caller/strategy in tier 1, gammaToLinear/turnOnTorch in tier 2). Those are invoke targets, never hook targets, and forcing deoptimize on them could have failed the whole tier on an unrelated method.

duplicateCardAudit.method: Parsed every HyperFeature literal in core/*.kt and compared both id and title across the whole catalog
duplicateCardAudit.conclusion: No duplicate feature cards remain. The previously merged groups (volume/brightness value display, gesture line, notification menu redirect, navigation-bar hiding, sunlight rows) are the only merges and they already collapse into one card each with tab-style options.

remainingNotMigrated.note: See docs/systemui-remaining-row-audit-2026-10-12.json and docs/systemui-remaining-row-audit-2026-10-12-third-pass.md. The six block-list icon rows are reachable through the local status_bar_icons adapter but need a device acceptance run; the three HD rows need a self-contained flow binding; battery_detail_at_right needs a real native right slot; the SuperLyric rows are an external dependency this project does not take.

verification: Local compile, 845-test Debug unit run, R8 Release assemble, 17 python tool tests, AKP install with a matching base.apk hash, and a launch smoke test. No host restart of com.android.systemui, no LSPosed scope re-enable and no on-device feature action was performed, so this is NOT runtime acceptance.
nextStep: Needs a real on-device acceptance pass: re-enable the host scope, restart the SystemUI host, and check the flashlight live slider, the 5G tile styles, and the six block-list icon rows.
